JOB DESCRIPTION FOR GENAI ENGINEER


Job Title: GenAI Engineer


Education: B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA / M.Sc. (Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science) or equivalent practical experience.


Experience: 110 Years


Skill Set:

  • Strong experience in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with FastAPI
  • Experience in developing REST APIs
  • Good knowledge of Git and Docker
  • Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) such as OpenAI GPT, Claude, Gemini, and Llama
  • Strong Prompt Engineering skills
  • Hands-on experience with LangChain and LangGraph
  • Experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or pgvector
  • Strong understanding of Embeddings and semantic search
  • Experience with Function Calling and Agentic AI
  • Experience in API development and Cloud Computing
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

Preferred Skills:

  • LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or AutoGen
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • LoRA and PEFT
  • Fine-Tuning Large Language Models
  • Hugging Face Transformers
  • Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes, or Terraform
  • AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Monitoring and Observability tools
  • Evaluation Frameworks and AI Guardrails

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Build scalable AI applications using FastAPI, REST APIs, and modern software engineering practices.
  • Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases and embeddings.
  • Integrate OpenAI GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and other foundation models into enterprise applications.
  • Develop AI agents and autonomous workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and related frameworks.
  • Build and optimize prompt engineering strategies for high-performing AI solutions.
  • Implement Function Calling and Agentic AI capabilities to automate business workflows.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and deliver AI-powered solutions.
  • Deploy, monitor, and optimize AI applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Continuously evaluate, fine-tune, and improve GenAI models for performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, and AI infrastructure.

Work Locations: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Mumbai, Gurugram, Noida, or Remote (India)


Work Mode: Work From Office (Onsite opportunities available)


Work Timings: 9:30 AM 6:30 PM


CTC: 12 LPA – 60 LPA

descriptionFromApi:
The Opportunity

The platform is built and going to market now - the agentic roadmap ships this year. The systems you build move real money, contact real people under real compliance constraints, and run autonomously at scale. Youll work directly with the founders: no layers, no ticket factory, genuine ownership end to end. Expanding across NZ, AU, and US.

The Role

Full-stack, AI-first, real engineer underneath. You build and ship features across UI, API routes, background jobs, and database. AI coding agents (Claude Code and similar) are a core part of the daily workflow - but you must be a real engineer underneath the tooling. The AI writes a lot of the code; you own the design, the correctness, and the explanation.

What You Will Do
  • Design, build, and ship features end to end: frontend, backend, schema, tests.
  • Use AI coding agents daily to plan, implement, review, and test - and know when not to trust them.
  • Review AI-generated and human-written code critically; catch bugs, security issues, and shortcuts before they ship.
  • Explain your work clearly: walk the team through what youre building, why it works, the trade-offs you made - demo it on ship.
  • Write clear PR descriptions, docs, and async updates others can act on without a meeting.
  • Debug production issues across the stack (app, database, background jobs, third-party APIs).
Must-Haves

Technical

1-3 years professional software development experience.

Solid TypeScript and React; comfortable with Next.js (App Router) or able to ramp fast.

Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases (Postgres via Supabase).

Understanding of REST APIs, auth, async patterns (queues, webhooks, background jobs).

Testing habits: unit and integration tests without being asked.

Can open the editor and solve the problem yourself when the agent is wrong, stuck, or unavailable. Our interview includes a no-AI coding round.

AI-agent fluency

  • Hands-on daily experience with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agent mode) - not just autocomplete.
  • Can scope a task for an agent, give it context, review its output line by line, and iterate.
  • Can tell when AI output is subtly wrong - understand why - and never merge code you dont.
Communication
  • Can explain a feature you built to an engineer, a PM, or a customer - at the right level for each.
  • Clear written English: PRs, docs, Slack updates.
  • Comfortable demoing your work and answering questions about how and why it works.
  • Interview includes presenting a feature youve built: what it does, how it works, what youd do differently.
Nice-To-Haves

Supabase (Postgres RLS migrations) Tailwind CSS shadcn/ui Zustand TanStack Query Payments / fintech domain Twilio SES VAPI Playwright / E2E testing pnpm workspaces Turborepo

Stack

Next.js 16 (App Router) React 19 TypeScript (strict, no any) Tailwind v4 Supabase (Postgres) shadcn/ui Zustand + TanStack Query Inngest Jest + Playwright Railway.

How We Work

Strict quality gates: no any, typed data access, full build and tests before merge. Async-first, light meeting load. We handle sensitive financial data and real-people communications, so we build with care - and hire people who feel the weight of that.

Location - Remote (NZ / AU / US) .

jobDescription:
Electrotech Power Solutions develops AI-powered solutions for highway surveillance, Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), and Multi-Lane Free Flow (MLFF) Tolling. We are looking for enthusiastic engineers who are passionate about Computer Vision and Artificial Intelligence.


This role is ideal for fresh graduates or final-year students who want hands-on experience building production AI systems. You will work on real-world projects involving CCTV analytics, Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR), vehicle detection, OCR, and Edge AI deployment on NVIDIA Jetson platforms.


No prior industry experience is required. A strong willingness to learn and build practical AI solutions is more important.



Role & responsibilities


AI & Computer Vision

  • Assist in training and evaluating computer vision models.
  • Prepare and clean datasets for AI model training.
  • Annotate images and videos using CVAT or similar annotation tools.
  • Improve model accuracy through data augmentation and experimentation.
  • Test and benchmark AI models on real-world highway CCTV footage.

Edge AI Development

  • Learn and work with NVIDIA DeepStream SDK and TensorRT.
  • Deploy AI models on NVIDIA Jetson edge devices.
  • Assist in optimizing inference speed and system performance.

Software Development

  • Develop Python scripts for data processing and automation.
  • Build utilities for AI model evaluation and deployment.
  • Work with Git for source code management.
  • Participate in debugging and improving AI applications.

Data & Backend

  • Work with PostgreSQL/Supabase databases.
  • Store and retrieve AI detection results.
  • Assist in API integration and dashboard development.

Documentation & Research

  • Document experiments, model performance, and deployment procedures.
  • Read research papers and evaluate new computer vision techniques.
  • Participate in R&D for AI-based highway monitoring and intelligent transportation solutions.

Preferred candidate profile


Technical skills

  • Good programming knowledge in Python.
  • Understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning fundamentals.
  • Basic knowledge of OpenCV.
  • Familiarity with TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Ultralytics YOLO.
  • Understanding of object detection or image classification concepts.
  • Basic knowledge of Git and GitHub.
  • Familiarity with Linux operating systems.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies quickly.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong attention to detail.

Preferred Skills (not mandatory)

  • Knowledge of NVIDIA Jetson, CUDA, TensorRT, or DeepStream.
  • Experience using Docker.
  • Familiarity with CVAT or Label Studio.

  • Experience with Bash scripting.
  • Contributions to GitHub or open-source projects



What You'll Learn

  • Production-grade Computer Vision pipelines.
  • Edge AI deployment using NVIDIA Jetson.
  • DeepStream SDK and TensorRT optimization.
  • Dataset creation and annotation workflows.
  • Docker and Linux-based deployments.
  • AI model optimization for real-time applications.
  • ITS and highway surveillance systems.
  • Software development best practices and version control.

About Kutlerri.ai


Kutlerri.ai builds AI agents for restaurants, focused on two outcomes: increasing revenue and reducing costs.


Our first AI agent, the Catering Sales Agent, is already live with paying US restaurant customers. It helps restaurants capture catering opportunities, respond to inquiries, send quotes, follow up with prospects, and turn one-time orders into repeat accounts.


We are now building the next generation of AI agents for restaurant operations across areas such as margin recovery, prep forecasting, menu economics, and customer retention.


That's where you come in.


About the Role


We are looking for a Founding Engineer who wants to build products from the ground up.


You will work directly with the founding team and own features end-to-end, from database schema to frontend, AI agent layer, integrations, deployment, and production monitoring.


This is a hands-on role in a small team. There is no "that's not my layer." One day you may build a product screen, the next you may work on LLM orchestration, and the next you may integrate with a POS system.

You will see your work in the hands of real restaurant operators quickly.


What You Will Own


Full-Stack Product Development

  • Build product experiences that restaurant operators can understand and use easily.
  • Own features from database/schema design to frontend implementation.
  • Work across frontend, backend, APIs, and infrastructure.
  • Build and ship production-ready features quickly.

AI Agents

  • Design and build AI agents using LLMs.
  • Work on prompts, tool use, memory, guardrails, and agent workflows.
  • Build evaluation systems to measure agent quality.
  • Make practical trade-offs between latency, reliability, and cost.

Integrations

  • Build integrations with POS systems, email platforms, telephony, calendars, and other third-party APIs.
  • Handle inconsistent APIs, messy data formats, authentication, retries, and edge cases.
  • Build clean internal abstractions over external systems.

Data

  • Build pipelines that transform messy restaurant data into reliable information AI agents can reason over.
  • Work with operational and transactional data.
  • Ensure data quality and reliability because bad data leads to bad agent decisions.

Production

  • Deploy and operate what you build.
  • Monitor production systems, investigate failures, and improve reliability.
  • Debug using logs, metrics, and real production behaviour.
  • Build systems that work reliably for customers, not just in development environments.

What We're Looking For


  • At least one product, application, or project that has been used by real people.
  • Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs / Generative AI, beyond simply calling an API.
  • Understanding of prompt engineering, tool calling, agent workflows, evaluations, latency, and cost trade-offs.
  • Comfortable working across frontend, backend, AI, and infrastructure.
  • Strong debugging skills and an ability to work through ambiguous technical problems.
  • Comfortable working with third-party APIs and integrations.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Willingness to work with US customers and occasionally overlap with US evening hours.

We care more about what you've built than how long you've been working.


A strong side project counts if real people have used it.


How We Work


  • Default Driver Mode: Own outcomes without waiting to be told what to do.
  • Customer Over Everything: Operator reality beats internal assumptions.
  • Ship, Learn, Fix, Repeat: Fast iteration is the strategy.
  • Progress Beats Perfection: A live v1 teaches more than a perfect specification.
  • Zero Ego: The best argument wins.

What Success Looks Like


In your first 6 months, you should have:

  • Shipped a second AI agent into production with paying design partners.
  • Built reliable integrations that operators rarely notice because they simply work.
  • Contributed to a codebase that is easier and faster for the next engineer to build on.

Why Join Us?


  • Work directly with the founding team.
  • Own meaningful technical and architectural decisions from day one.
  • Build AI products used by real US restaurant operators.
  • No ticket queue between you and the customer.
  • Fast decisions and rapid product launches.
  • High ownership and visibility.
  • Competitive compensation for the stage.

How to Apply


We don't need a long cover letter.


Tell us about the best thing you've built and what broke when real people first used it.


Send your resume + GitHub, portfolio, live product, or project links to:

careers@kutlerri.ai

Imitate Labs is building Aurra Sales Agent, an AI powered voice calling platform helping B2B businesses across India automate customer conversations. We serve Real Estate, Insurance, Automotive, Healthcare, EdTech, and NBFC clients.

Core Focus AI, Models & Intelligence


1. Model Evaluation & Cost Optimization

- Evaluate and compare LLM, Speech to Text, Text to Speech, and voice agent options to bring down inference and infrastructure cost without hurting conversation quality.

- Develop agentic workflows with tool calling that reason across multiple business processes.

- Build test harnesses that measure response quality, latency, and cost per conversation, and improve all three over time.

Build the next generation of Aurra's intelligence layer, sold as a premium product to clients:

- AI powered lead scoring

- Conversation sentiment analysis

- Objection detection and pattern analysis

- Call quality and performance insights

- Personalized script recommendations

- Client health scoring

- Integrate AI services with CRMs, WhatsApp, Email, dashboards, and internal applications.

- Build workflows with real monitoring, retries, logging, and failure recovery.


Also Part of the Role Building & Running What You Ship


5. Backend & Systems Engineering

- Build Python services for the AI and voice layer agent runtime, LLM and speech provider integrations, and data pipelines.

- Build and maintain our Node.js / TypeScript (NestJS) backend and REST APIs campaign management, call orchestration, integrations, admin tooling, and client-facing endpoints.

- Work on real time, low latency systems: WebSocket services, streaming audio pipelines, event driven flows, and sub second response budgets.

- Integrate telephony providers, CRMs, messaging platforms, and client systems via REST APIs and webhooks.

- Manage cloud and inference cost right sizing, scaling, and eliminating waste.

8. Growth Engineering & AI Integrations

- Integrate Meta Ads, websites, CRMs, and communication platforms.

- Own model evaluation. Build the harnesses, define the metrics and produce the evidence that a change helped. We would rather have an unglamorous eval suite than a confident opinion.
- Deploy and operate inference workloads on GCP and Vertex AI, and contribute to sizing and configuration for on premises open weight model hosting.
- Integrate AI capability into the wider product surface through APIs, webhooks and event driven pipelines.
- Work with the AI Product Owner to turn requirements into technical designs, and push back when the requirement and the technology disagree.

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vistas presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations reinforcing Indias strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.

About Amtech

Amtech is scaling its Platform Engineering organization in India as our products move to a fully AWS-hosted, multi-tenant SaaS model. Our SRE practice keeps Encore, LabelTraxx, and supporting platforms reliable, observable, and secure across a multi-account AWS estate. As a senior individual contributor on the SRE track, you will own the reliability of significant production domains, design the observability and automation frameworks the team standardizes on, and act as incident commander for complex, cross-service incidents. You will raise the bar for the India SRE pod: setting patterns, reviewing designs, and mentoring earlier-career engineers while remaining deeply hands-on.

Our Employee Value Proposition

At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:

- Purpose Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations.

- Growth Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vistas global network accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.

-Culture Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.

-Innovation Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.


Role Description

Amtech is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Cloud API & Label Traxx engineering team, driving the ongoing development of our AWS-hosted Cloud API and the modernization of our flagship Label Traxx ERP platform, a mature enterprise system serving the packaging and printing industries.

This role owns complex, ambiguous engineering problems within the team, driving technical quality and best practices across system design, scalable architecture, testing, reliability, and secure engineering spanning both the .NET/AWS-based Cloud API and our legacy 4D-based application. Prior 4D or AWS experience is not required, but the ability to quickly learn and work within established and evolving architectures is essential.

The ideal candidate brings strong enterprise application development experience, deep understanding of business logic–driven systems, solid relational database skills, and working familiarity with cloud infrastructure. Over time, this role will take on greater ownership of the Cloud API’s AWS environment as the platform continues to modernize.

We value engineers who embrace modern development practices, including collaborative Git workflows, CI/CD, Agile delivery, and responsible use of AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and code quality.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own projects or major features end-to-end across the Cloud API (.NET /C#, AWS) and Label Traxx ERP (4D) platforms, driving delivery predictability and measurable business outcomes.
  • Drive technical quality and best practices across system design, scalable architecture, code quality, testing, reliability, maintainability, and secure engineering.
  • Analyze and extend complex business logic across operational workflows such as order management, production, inventory, and finance.
  • Work within Amtech’s AWS environment (API Gateway, ECS Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Secrets Manager) to build, deploy, and troubleshoot Cloud API services.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues while ensuring high system reliability and performance across both platforms.
  • Mentor engineers consistently and help shape team-level engineering standards and practices.
  • Design and optimize database queries (relational and NoSQL) while maintaining strong data integrity standards.
  • Align with Product, QA, and Support teams by communicating decisions, trade-offs, risks, and implementation plans clearly.
  • Participate in code reviews and manage pull requests using GitHub best practices; contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements.
  • Contribute actively to Agile ceremonies and backlog tracking using Jira.
  • Promote effective use of AI-assisted development tools to enhance engineering efficiency and quality.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 6+ years of experience in enterprise software development.
  • Strong object-oriented programming experience (C#/.NET preferred; Java or similar acceptable).
  • Working experience with AWS cloud services (API Gateway, ECS/Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, or similar) — hands-on API/AWS exposure required.
  • Experience working on complex ERP, manufacturing, financial, or other business-critical systems.
  • Strong relational database experience (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or equivalent); exposure to NoSQL data stores a plus.
  • Solid understanding of transactional systems, data modeling, and scalable service architecture.
  • Experience maintaining and modernizing legacy or monolithic applications.
  • Hands-on experience with Git-based version control (GitHub preferred) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams using Jira or similar tools.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective communication skills and demonstrated ability to mentor peers and influence team practices.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex) is a plus.

Why Join Amtech

At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

AayuVerse is building technology-driven solutions to help businesses become more efficient, productive and digitally enabled. As an early-stage company, we are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive who is creative, energetic, target-oriented and willing to take ownership of digital marketing activities.


The role will primarily involve digital marketing and online presence management for AayuVerse and its clients. You will work on social media, content creation, digital campaigns, online business presence, lead generation and other digital marketing activities based on client requirements.


You will also interact with business owners and potential customers to understand their digital marketing needs, suggest suitable solutions, coordinate campaigns and help businesses improve their visibility and customer engagement across digital channels.


As AayuVerse follows an AI-first and technology-first approach, the role also requires someone who is willing to learn and adopt new technologies, AI-enabled solutions and digital marketing tools.   • Proficiency in creating engaging content for various platforms (social media).
  • Ability to analyze data from Google Analytics to inform future marketing decisions.

title: AI Automation Engineer
jobDescription:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Golden Jackal Studios is building one of Indias first AI-first kids animation studios. Were looking for a hands-on AI Automation Engineer who can build the backend systems and workflow pipelines that power our content generation stack. You will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining automation workflows that connect creative tools, internal systems, cloud infrastructure, and production processes. This includes helping us automate parts of image, video, audio, and asset workflows so the studio can create content faster, more reliably, and at higher quality.


This is not a pure research or model-building role. We are looking for an engineer first someone who enjoys building working systems, integrating APIs, managing cloud workflows, and solving production problems in a fast-moving environment.


WHAT YOULL DO

Workflow Automation & Pipeline Building

  • Build and maintain automated workflows for creative production across image, video, audio, and related operations
  • Use tools like n8n, along with custom scripts and services, to orchestrate multi-step production pipelines
  • Connect generation tools, storage systems, internal databases, and review workflows
  • Design systems with retries, fallbacks, queueing, logging, and monitoring
  • Reduce manual effort in content production through robust workflow design

API Integration & Orchestration

  • Integrate third-party APIs across media generation, voice, transcription, storage, notifications, and workflow tools
  • Build webhook-based and event-driven systems across multiple services
  • Handle authentication, payload design, async jobs, rate limits, and failure recovery
  • Create lightweight services to validate, transform, and route data between tools
  • Ensure systems are modular so new tools can be added as the stack evolves

Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment

  • Deploy and manage automation systems on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Work with services such as Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub,Cloud Storage, Firestore, and related infrastructure
  • Manage job execution, scheduling, storage, and backend services required for production workflows
  • Improve system reliability, speed, and cost efficiency
  • Support containerized or script-based deployments where needed

Engineering for Production

  • Write production-grade code in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Build internal backend utilities and services to support automated content workflows
  • Monitor system performance and debug failures across connected tools and services
  • Document workflows, system logic, and infrastructure clearly
  • Help create a maintainable and scalable technical backbone for the studio

Internal Tooling & Creative Interfaces

  • Build lightweight internal web tools that let the creative team interact with production
  • workflows submitting loglines, reviewing generated images, approving or refining video outputs
  • Design simple, functional interfaces for non-technical users that sit on top of automated backend pipelines
  • Comfort using no-code/low-code UI tools (such as Lovable, Retool, or similar) to ship internal dashboards and review interfaces this is not a frontend role, but you should be able to get something usable in front of the team quickly

Collaboration & Systems Thinking

  • Work closely with creative and product teams to convert messy manual workflows into clean technical systems
  • Understand production bottlenecks and engineer around them
  • Balance speed with reliability in a startup environment
  • Evaluate new tools and APIs for integration into the workflow stack
  • Help shape the long-term architecture of the studios automation layer

PREFERRED SKILLS


Tools & Technologies

  • Make.com, n8n or similar workflow orchestration tools
  • GCP (Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Firestore, BigQuery)
  • Python and/or JavaScript / TypeScript
  • APIs, webhooks, OAuth, JSON payloads, background jobs, and async workflows
  • Git / GitHub
  • Docker (preferred)
  • Comfort using no-code/low-code UI tools (such as Lovable, Retool, or similar)
  • FFmpeg or media-processing workflows (preferred)
  • Familiarity with AI-powered APIs or creative tools is a plus
  • ComfyUI or open-source model workflows (optional)

Engineering Strengths

  • Strong backend and automation fundamentals
  • Good understanding of event-driven systems and async workflows
  • Ability to debug complex multi-step automations
  • Ability to design systems, not just scripts
  • Good sense of modularity, maintainability, and reliability
  • Comfort working with production systems in a fast-changing environment

Mindset

  • Loves building real working systems
  • Learns fast and adapts quickly
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging ability
  • Detail-oriented and structured
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Enjoys turning chaos into process

Nice to Have

  • Experience with media generation or creative automation pipelines
  • Experience integrating image, video, voice, or transcription tools
  • Experience in a startup, content, or applied AI environment
  • Familiarity with cloud and API cost optimisation
  • Understanding of how creative production teams work

EDUCATION

  • We care more about your work than your degree. Relevant backgrounds include:
  • B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or related fields
  • MCA / BCA / B.Sc. Computer Science
  • Strong self-taught engineers with relevant project experience
  • Candidates with solid GitHub projects in automation, backend systems, or applied engineering workflows

WHY JOIN US

  • Be part of India’s first AI-first kids’ content universe
  • Build the automation backbone of a modern content studio
  • Work on real applied systems, not just prototypes
  • Get high ownership and room to shape technical systems from scratch
  • Work with cutting-edge creative and production tools
  • Grow quickly into senior technical or architecture roles

HOW TO APPLY


Share the following on the provided email ID: info@goldenjackalstudios.com

  • Latest CV or link to your LinkedIn profile
  • GitHub profile (preferred)

descriptionFromApi:
About the Role

We're looking for an AI Business Analyst who can understand real-world business and finance workflows and figure out how AI and technology can make them dramatically better.

This is a client-facing, hands-on role at the intersection of business, finance, AI and software. You'll work directly with customers to understand how they operate, spot problems and opportunities and translate what you learn into clear specifications our technical team can build from.

This isn't a role for someone who only documents requirements. We want someone curious, who experiments with AI constantly, challenges existing processes, and can imagine better ways of working then help make them real.


What You'll Do

  • Talk directly with customers to understand their business processes, pain points and requirements.
  • Study existing workflows and find where AI, automation or software can improve them.
  • Translate business requirements into clear workflows, user stories and technical specs developers can act on.
  • Work closely with developers and AI engineers through implementation.
  • Test solutions from the customer's perspective and make sure they solve the real problem.
  • Prototype and experiment with AI tools to validate ideas quickly.
  • Research new AI capabilities and find practical ways to apply them.
  • Bridge the gap between customers, business teams and technical teams.
  • Take part in customer demos, onboarding and feedback sessions.

What We're Looking For

  • A background in or strong understanding of finance, commerce or a related business domain.
  • Fluency with AI tools, and real interest in experimenting with new models, agents and workflows.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
  • A knack for understanding complex processes and simplifying them.
  • Ability to translate business needs into requirements developers can build from.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Comfort speaking directly with customers, including senior finance people.
  • Curiosity, creativity and a willingness to experiment.
  • Ability to learn fast and work independently.

What Makes This Role Different

This is not a traditional BA role built around documents and meetings. You'll have real freedom to explore, experiment and build.

One day you might be understanding how a customer's finance team processes hundreds of documents; the next, experimenting with AI agents to automate part of that workflow; the next, working with developers to turn the idea into a product. If you find a better way to solve a problem, you'll have the freedom to pursue it.


You Might Be a Great Fit If You

  • Use Claude, ChatGPT or other AI tools extensively and are always testing their limits.
  • Enjoy understanding how businesses actually work.
  • Can hold a conversation with a CFO, business owner or a manager, then explain their problem clearly to a developer.
  • Ask good questions and get to the root of a problem.
  • Prefer solving problems to following processes.
  • Are genuinely excited about how AI will reshape finance and business operations.

We are looking for someone who can understand product requirements, solve technical problems independently, and take ownership of development from implementation to deployment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain scalable backend applications using Python.
  • Build REST APIs, background jobs, asynchronous services, and data-processing pipelines.
  • Develop backend systems for AI-powered products, automation tools, and data-driven applications.
  • Work with structured and unstructured datasets and optimize data-processing workflows.
  • Design and manage PostgreSQL databases and write efficient SQL queries.
  • Integrate LLMs, AI APIs, machine learning models, vector databases, and third-party services.
  • Build and maintain Docker-based development and deployment environments.
  • Improve application performance, reliability, security, and scalability.
  • Debug technical issues and deliver production-ready solutions.
  • Collaborate with frontend and product teams and support full-stack integration when required.

Required Technical Skills

  • Minimum 2 years of professional Python development experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Python, OOP, data structures, and algorithms.
  • Hands-on experience with FastAPI, Django, Flask, or similar backend frameworks.
  • Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL, relational databases, and SQL optimization.
  • Experience building and integrating REST APIs.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Docker Compose.
  • Experience processing and manipulating data using Pandas, NumPy, Polars, PySpark, or similar tools.
  • Understanding of asynchronous programming, background jobs, and task-processing systems.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and Linux-based environments.
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

AI & Advanced Development Experience

  • Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)
  • OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source model APIs
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
  • AI agents and tool-calling workflows
  • Prompt engineering and structured AI outputs
  • Embeddings and semantic search
  • Vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Chroma, Milvus, or pgvector
  • NLP and machine learning model integration
  • AI-powered automation and workflow development
  • Recommendation, ranking, matching, or classification systems

Full-Stack Exposure

descriptionFromApi:
Maintics Automation & Robotics LLP is a Gurugram-based industrial automation firm. Alongside our control panel and PLC work, we build the software that plants run on: production traceability systems that record every part as it is made, and a SCADA platform that puts live shop-floor data in front of operators and management.


This is our software team's next hire, and the work is real product work not tickets. You will build features that end up running in a factory, where somebody depends on the number on the screen being right.


We build with AI in the loop, deliberately. Our developers use AI coding tools every day and we expect you to be fast with them. We also expect you to read, question and test everything they produce. If you enjoy working that way moving quickly but staying responsible for the code with your name on it you will like it here.



What you will do

Build and maintain the traceability and SCADA web application: Django REST APIs, PostgreSQL data models, React screens for operators and management.


Build dashboards, production reports, traceability lookups and exports that people use in real audits.



Take a feature from a rough description on a call to something running at a customer's plant, including being the person who fixes it when it breaks during a night shift.

Deploy and maintain with Docker, keep environments, backups and versions in order.

Write things down schema notes, API docs, how to bring the system up from nothing.

Visit a customer plant occasionally so you can see the machine your software is counting.

What you must bring

1–2 years writing production code that real users depended on. Personal projects count only if somebody other than you used them.

Python and Django — or another server framework you can defend in detail — and REST API design.

React with modern JavaScript or TypeScript.

Real SQL on PostgreSQL or MySQL: joins, indexes, and the ability to explain why a query is slow.

Git as a habit, comfort on Linux, and enough Docker to run and debug a container.

Genuine fluency with AI coding tools — and the honesty to tell us where they got things wrong. We will ask, and a good answer counts in your favour.

The ability to read code you did not write and explain what it does. This is the single skill we screen hardest for.

Work from our Gurugram office, with occasional visits to customer sites.

B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA or equivalent. If you are self-taught and your work speaks for itself, apply anyway — show us what you have built.

Loomlight Interactive is hiring creative and talented 2D Game Artists across all experience levels from interns taking their first professional steps to experienced artists ready to lead. ABOUT LOOMLIGHT INTERACTIVE

Loomlight Interactive is a Bengaluru-based game studio crafting immersive mobile experiences, including narrative-driven hidden-object and adventure games. We're a small, collaborative team that values craft, creativity, and a shared love of great games. This is a fully remote role.


THE ROLE

As a 2D Artist, you'll collaborate closely with developers and game designers to bring game worlds, characters, and concepts to life through compelling visuals. Your day-to-day contribution will scale with your experience level, but every artist on our team helps shape the look and feel of our games.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with developers and game designers to create high-quality 2D art assets for games.
  • Create in-game artwork including character designs, backgrounds, props, and placeholder assets.
  • Produce visually engaging illustrations for in-game content and marketing materials.
  • Ensure all visual assets align with the overall artistic direction and style of the game.
  • Provide quick sketches and visualizations based on written briefs or brainstorming sessions.
  • Communicate visual ideas clearly and solve design challenges with creative solutions.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR (all levels)

  • Strong sketching and visualization skills, with the ability to quickly translate ideas into visuals.
  • A background in illustration with the flexibility to work across multiple art styles, from photo-realistic to highly stylized.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and familiarity with other digital art and concept tools.
  • A solid understanding of color theory, lighting, composition, anatomy, and visual aesthetics.
  • Excellent visual communication skills and a genuine passion for gaming and digital experiences.
  • A 2D art portfolio showcasing a range of styles and creative projects (required for all applicants).

EXPERIENCE LEVELS

  • Intern — Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree/diploma in art, design, or a related field. Foundational drawing and digital art skills, a strong willingness to learn, and an eagerness to grow within a professional studio.
  • Junior 2D Artist — Up to ~2 years of experience or an equivalently strong portfolio. Able to produce production-ready assets with guidance and iterate quickly on feedback.
  • Experienced 2D Artist — 2+ years creating art for games or digital products. Able to own assets end-to-end, design characters, props, and environments independently, and help guide and mentor junior artists. Familiarity with 2D animation tools (e.g. Spine or Unity 2D Animation) is a plus.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Hands-on experience working on exciting mobile gaming projects.
  • Mentorship from experienced developers and industry professionals.
  • A collaborative and innovative remote work environment.
  • Interns: a competitive stipend during the internship period, with the opportunity for full-time employment based on performance.

  • Location: Remote
  • Employment type: Full-time positions available
  • Start date: Immediate

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through LinkedIn, or send your resume and a link to your 2D art portfolio (this is essential) to:


Krishnakumar, Loomlight Interactive

Email: admin@loomlightinteractive.com

Phone: +91 96336 33744 / +91 97421 51616


If you're ready to turn your passion for game art into an extraordinary career, join Loomlight Interactive and be part of our journey to create outstanding mobile gaming experiences. Apply now and let's build something remarkable together!

Job Summary

You'll help build the backend and ML platforms that turn multi-sensor satellite data into geospatial intelligence and you'll build them to run fully air-gapped and offline, deployed inside defense and intelligence environments with no internet access.

What you'll actually do

  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs that fuse satellite data (SAR + MSI) and serve geospatial analytics to analysts.
  • Design and work with databases and data flows for large raster/imagery datasets; model the data, write queries and pipelines that hold up at scale.
  • Put ML models behind reliable, self-hosted services: take something that works in a notebook and make it a monitored, production service that runs offline.
  • Work on inference and ML pipelines for imagery/geospatial analytics: batching, latency vs. throughput, GPU constraints, keeping things healthy in an air-gapped deployment.
  • Contribute to analyst-facing and agentic tooling components that chain steps, call local tools, and support intelligence workflows (and fail gracefully when they don't).
  • Debug systems where "correct" is fuzzy, and build the evals and monitoring that tell us whether a change actually made things better.

What you'll learn here

  • Because this matters as much as the work:
  • How to build production ML and data systems under real constraints offline, on-prem, security-first a skill very few engineers ever develop.
  • How to reason about systems that are probabilistic-ally correct, not just pass/fail.
  • Applied geospatial/EO machine learning and multi-sensor data fusion, mentored by [a lead with ML engineering experience / the team].
  • How to stay sharp without managed services reading source code and papers, and self-hosting what others just call an API for.

Requirements

  • ~1-2 years of backend engineering / ML engineering experience.
  • Strong fundamentals you understand why, not just which framework method to call. You can reason about what happens between a request arriving and a response leaving.
  • Systematic debugging. When something breaks, you form a hypothesis, reproduce it, and narrow it down you don't just try random fixes. (This matters double when you can't google your way out live.)
  • Evidence you learn fast and on your own. You've picked up something hard recently and can explain both the thing and how you learned it.
  • You surface blockers early and communicate clearly when you're stuck.
  • Comfort with constraints and process. Security discipline, careful data handling, and working within an air-gapped environment are part of the job, not obstacles to route around.
  • Curiosity about ML/AI with some hands-on exposure ideally you've run a model locally/self-hosted rather than only via a cloud API.

Bonus (nice to have)

  • Geospatial / remote-sensing experience: GDAL, rasterio, QGIS, working with satellite imagery, SAR, or multi-spectral data.
  • Self-hosting or serving ML models on-prem (e.g. Triton, ONNX Runtime, local LLMs, vLLM).
  • Experience with air-gapped, on-prem, or high-security deployments; reproducible builds; offline package mirroring.
  • Familiarity with containerization for isolated environments (Docker/K8s), and GPU-based inference.
  • Exposure to observability, evals, or testing non-deterministic systems.
  • Comfort reading a papers method section or an unfamiliar librarys source.

At Kapture CX, we are looking for an Analyst - Platform Operations in our Customer Experience team.

You will develop internal scripts and utilities to handle bulk or recurring issues at scale - reducing ticket volume and manual effort over time.
You will support RCA for major incidents, identify systemic root causes, and work with Product and Engineering teams to ensure preventive actions are implemented.
You will analyze ticket trends and platform telemetry to surface patterns and translate them into actionable inputs for the right team.
You will validate API behavior across client gateway backend chains; clearly distinguish client-side failures (payload, auth, headers) from server-side issues (latency, errors, downtime).
You will support deployment validation and production release monitoring and automate repeatable checks wherever possible.
This is a Bangalore-based role . We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in-person interactions fuel innovation and agility.
What does success look like in this role

Reduced MTTR for critical and high-priority issues.
SLA adherence for issue response and resolution.
Volume of recurring tickets eliminated through tooling, automation, or permanent fixes.
Dashboard adoption - stakeholders actively using operational views built by this role.
Reduction in manual, repetitive operational tasks over time.

You have a Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
You have 1-3 years of experience in a technical analyst, application support, or platform operations role.

You have strong knowledge of APIs, REST services, and HTTP semantics (status codes, retries, timeouts, throttling).
You have experience writing scripts or utilities (Python, SQL, or equivalent) to automate analysis or bulk remediation.
You have hands-on experience with ticketing systems (Jira, ServiceNow, or Zendesk) and API testing tools (Postman or equivalent).
What are the most critical skills for this role
You have experience with Observability Dashboarding - designing monitoring views that surface the right signal for engineering and business stakeholders.
You have experience with Utility Development - writing tools that solve operational problems at scale, not just one ticket at a time.
You have experience with API Integration Tracing - tracing end-to-end flows and isolating failure ownership across client, gateway, and backend layers.
You have experience with Pattern Recognition - moving from individual incidents to systemic insight; knowing when a ticket is a symptom, not the cause.
You have strong Cross-functional Communication skills - translating technical findings into precise, timestamped artifacts that engineering teams can act on immediately.
You will have an advantage if you:
You have experience working in SaaS platform environments.
You have exposure to production release monitoring and deployment validation.
You have experience building operational tooling and automation workflows.
You have experience identifying recurring issue patterns and driving preventive fixes.

Opportunity to work on large-scale SaaS systems.
Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, Product, and Customer teams.
Opportunity to build tools and automation that directly influence platform efficiency and reliability.
Opportunity to solve operational challenges with measurable business impact.

jobDescription:
We are looking forward to hire Microsoft Fabric Professionals in the following areas :

: Data Engineer (Mid-Senior)
Experience Level: 5+ Years ( Microsoft Fabric: 1-2 Years )
Role Overview
We are seeking a Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience to design and implement scalable data solutions on Microsoft Fabric . You will be a key technical contributor, responsible for building end-to-end data pipelines, managing OneLake storage, and ensuring the reliability of Lakehouse and Warehouse environments. This role requires a professional who has already transitioned into the Fabric ecosystem and can independently deliver complex data engineering tasks.
Key Responsibilities
  • Fabric Pipeline Engineering: Design and develop production-grade ETL/ELT workflows using Fabric Data Factory , Dataflows Gen2 , and Notebooks .
  • Data Lake Management: Implement and manage OneLake organization and Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) to ensure data quality and performance.
  • Advanced Spark Development: Write and optimize PySpark and Spark SQL code for high-volume data processing and transformation.
  • Semantic Modeling: Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (Direct Lake / Import) to support enterprise reporting requirements.
  • DevOps Automation: Manage Fabric artifacts using Git integration and deployment pipelines (CI/CD) in Azure DevOps or GitHub.
  • Performance Optimization: Conduct performance tuning of Spark clusters and SQL queries to ensure cost-efficient capacity utilization in Fabric.
  • Collaboration: Partner with Lead Engineers and Architects to implement data governance, security (RLS/OLS), and cataloging within Microsoft Purview .
Must-Have Skills
  • Experience: 4+ years of overall data engineering experience.
  • Microsoft Fabric: 1-2 years of proven, hands-on experience with core Fabric components (Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, and Data Factory).
  • Core Technicals: Expert-level SQL and strong proficiency in PySpark .
  • Data Architecture: Proven experience implementing dimensional models and Lakehouse patterns.
  • Azure Foundations: Solid understanding of ADLS Gen2, Azure SQL, and Key Vault as they integrate with Fabric.
  • Modern DevOps: Experience with Git-based version control and automated deployment workflows for data.
Good-to-Have Skills
  • Real-Time Intelligence: Experience with KQL or Eventstreams within the Fabric ecosystem.
  • Migrations: Previous experience migrating workloads from Azure Synapse or Databricks to Fabric.
  • Certifications: Microsoft DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate) or DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer Associate).
  • Governance: Exposure to data lineage and sensitivity labeling within Microsoft Purview.
Soft Skills Education
  • Mindset: A quality-first approach with a strong "bias for action" in solving technical debt.
  • Communication: Ability to clearly document technical designs and collaborate in a pod-based team structure.
  • Education: Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related Engineering field.

Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles

  • Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
  • Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
  • All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
  • Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

Job Summary

The Employee Life Cycle Analyst (Tier 1) plays a key frontline role in APAC HR Operations, ensuring core employee life cycle transactions are delivered accurately, on time, and with care. From hire to retire, this role helps ensure employees are supported seamlessly across their journey. This is more than an administrative role. You will work in a digital-first HR environment using tools such as Workday, ServiceNow, chatbots, and payroll vendor platforms, supporting automation, self-service, and process simplification. You ll help maintain high data integrity, support payroll and compliance reporting, track operational metrics, and proactively flag risks and improvement opportunities. Designed as a launchpad role, this position offers exposure to global HR operations, payroll processes, compliance frameworks, and modern HR technologies-setting you up for future growth as a payroll or employee life cycle specialist. Note: this is going to be a 1 year contract role.

Responsibilities

  • Digital-First Enablement: Work on tickets in ServiceNow, providing timely resolution of employee queries.
  • Support automation initiatives, e-signatures, and digital workflows with HRIS.
  • Learn and adopt analytics tools for data handling reporting.
  • Insights Continuous Improvement: Contribute ideas to simplify payroll processes and improve employee experience.

  • Compliance Documentation: Maintain employee records and documentation in line with company policies and local regulations. Support statutory and internal audits by ensuring data is complete and accurate. Keep SOPs, FAQs, and process documentation current.

  • Support onboarding with zero errors and on time with digitized documentation.
  • Documentation complete, accurate, and always audit-ready.
  • Employee queries resolved quickly and accurately, with a service-first mindset.
  • SOPs, checklists, and trackers kept up to date and error-free.
  • Recognized as a reliable and detail-oriented team player.
  • Employee and manager queries resolved with accuracy and empathy.

  • Minimum 1 years of experience in HR operations. (internship/project experience acceptable).
  • Familiarity with HR systems (Workday, ServiceNow) is an advantage.
  • Strong proficiency in MS Excel for reconciliations, validations, data audits and reporting.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, global environment.
  • Eagerness to learn, grow, and build a career in PC Operations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Clear communication skills with a service-oriented mindset.
  • Eagerness to learn, adapt, and grow in a digital-first HR environment.

What we need to see from you

  • 1-2 years of experience in HR Operations
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort working with HR systems and data
  • Exposure to onboarding, data handling and reporting is a strong advantage
